policy.circularity_guard: No certificate may depend evidentially on its own output through an unbroken cycle.

rules.name: handoff_composition_candidate
propose: X HANDOFF_TO Z

rules.name: native_cross_branch_synthesis
propose: cross_branch_synthesis_task

rules.name: domain_boundary_firewall
when: generated result changes domain contract or introduces primitive/axiom/unlicensed transformation
propose: DOMAIN_EXTENSION_PROPOSAL

rules.name: closure_certificate_self_promotion
propose: promote candidate to DERIVED_CLOSED_INTERNAL

rules.name: mobius_closure_equivariance_audit
when: result has typed H action or orientation scope
propose: compare Cl_RR(H(x)) with H(Cl_RR(x)) under declared equivalence; record defect rather than force equality

rules.name: recursive_perturbation_impact
propose: compute dependency impact cone
invalidate affected certificates
iterate reclosure in isolated branch
report conflicts/forks

rules.name: witness_fiber_separation
propose: test witness collisions on each recovery-relevant merge fiber
promote fiber-separation criterion with valid certificate

rules.name: core_witness_counterexample
when: two distinct fine lineages share one coarse readout
propose: record @core_witness_collision
mark unqualified universal core sufficiency false

rules.name: minimal_recovery_discriminator
propose: introduce derived @recovery_discriminator role
test existing source-backed History/holonomy components before adding new structure

rules.name: history_counterexample_repair
when: colliding lineages have distinct retained ordered History
propose: test History-augmented bundle for separation
do not promote full History as globally minimal from one counterexample

rules.name: recovery_context_equivalence
propose: define contextual recovery equivalence over all admissible left/right History contexts
test equivalence and congruence laws

rules.name: recovery_signature_quotient
propose: construct @recovery_history_signature_quotient
induce @recovery_signature_composition from History composition

rules.name: recovery_signature_minimality
when: recovery tests are declared complete for the selected recovery contract
propose: prove quotient recovery sufficiency
prove quotient is coarsest compositional recovery-sufficient signature relative to declared test family

rules.name: holonomy_signature_realization
propose: test source Sig_Hol fields against abstract quotient
remove fields only by counterexample-safe redundancy proof
retain full History when finite field subset is not separating

rules.name: signature_kernel_equivalence
propose: derive kernel equivalence h~_sigma k iff sigma(h)=sigma(k)

rules.name: signature_resolution_defects
propose: search underresolution pairs ker(sigma)\~_Rec
search overresolution pairs ~_Rec\ker(sigma)

rules.name: exact_recovery_signature_realization
propose: certify exact realization iff ker(sigma)=~_Rec

rules.name: holonomy_field_projection_crawl
propose: test field subsets against under/overresolution defects
do not treat D57 scaffold as closed minimal signature without kernel equality proof

rules.name: signature_role_normalization
propose: factor flat signature into typed envelope plus structural payload
preserve joined-record equivalence
do not infer kernel reduction from payload reduction

rules.name: recovery_test_family_instantiation_gate
when: concrete signature kernel is to be compared with Recovery Context Equivalence
propose: require instantiated recovery test basis or equivalent oracle
block exact field-minimality certification while test-family completeness is only schematic

rules.name: d57_history_class_source_audit
when: D57 [h] is used as a signature field
propose: search mounted sources for defining equivalence
refuse unlicensed identification with [h]_Id or [h]_Rec

rules.name: signature_role_separation
when: Sig_Rec is closed as minimal recovery quotient
Sig_Hol source definition packages distinct component effects
propose: separate recovery-selector role from holonomy-diagnostic role
require kernel equality only when one object is explicitly assigned to realize the other role

rules.name: number_object_readout_return
when: tool/infrastructure branch is no longer foundationally blocking
propose: build Number Dependency Landscape from object, Resolution, transduction, structural zero, closed-domain unity, objectivity, and parked number ontology
generate next number question from landscape rather than importing arithmetic

rules.name: formal_object_before_optional_valuation
when: native formal object exists independently of optional scalar valuation
source explicitly calls scalar an optional readout/summary
propose: separate formal-object role from valuation-output role
certify object-before-scalarization ordering
separate valuation role from generic classifier role

rules.name: remove_numeric_codomain_circularity
when: valuation source uses a predeclared conventional numerical codomain
root question asks what makes an output numerical without presupposing number ontology
propose: replace numerical codomain with uninterpreted summary domain V for foundational test
register codomain circularity defect
advance to structural characterization of V

rules.name: unit_normalization_role_separation
when: source U_1 contains admissible configuration changes
all admitted U_1 configurations satisfy ell(c)=1
propose: type 1 as unit-normalization value in this source context
reject counting interpretation of the same token
guard against identification with other 1-labeled objects without witness

rules.name: unit_relative_valuation_frontier
when: source provides recoverable normalized unit object/value
propose: test whether numerical role can be generated relative to a unit normalization object
avoid importing division or arithmetic ratio
require transduction/provenance compatibility

rules.name: valuation_fiber_factorization
when: valuation equality is available in V
propose: define x ~_v y iff v(x)=v(y)
form Q_v=X/~_v
factor v through Q_v
preserve source-object provenance upstream

rules.name: order_before_number_probe
when: source structural order exists before optional scalarization
propose: register source order as nonnumerical structural comparison
reject order alone as sufficient characterization of number

rules.name: unit_order_reparameterization_probe
when: value domain has equality/order and distinguished unit
no richer scale law is declared
propose: construct structure-preserving reparameterization stabilizer
test whether nontrivial relabelings preserve all declared data
if yes, register underdetermination rather than numerical closure

rules.name: relative_value_transport_frontier
when: fiber quotient, order, and unit remain insufficient
propose: test presentation-independent relative transport between value classes
require composition/provenance compatibility
do not name transport addition, ratio, or division without derivation
